content_rating: fully graphic body horror; gore, viscera, and mutilation are core visual language
token_ring: One shared ring for every family so tokens read as one collection: a raised circular rim of blackened, pitted iron with a thin old-brass inner lip and a few rust blooms, no lettering. Portrait background inside the ring uses the family's palette. Real alpha transparency outside the ring.

family_palettes.coast: green-black water, grey foam, salt-white crust, drowned blue-grey flesh, waterlogged wood, rope and net, barnacle
family_palettes.forest: wet bark, antler, root, moss over bone, pale fungus, leaf-litter brown, deep shadow green
family_palettes.mines: coal black, raw iron, tallow yellow, splintered pit-prop timber, crushed bone, lamp-orange
family_palettes.city: plaster and brick dust, soot, lead grey, stained cloth, wax, flesh behind masks
family_palettes.haunts: cemetery: wet clay, lichen, tarnished silver, shroud linen; tavern: spilled ale amber, split wood, bruise purple, blood on sawdust; brothel: rouge, silk, candle wax, pox scars, brass bed rails
